privacy:
Privacy policy

Last updated: 29 September 2026

1. Data controller

The data controller is Letrion Labs di Nazario De Letteriis, a sole proprietorship based at Viale Marina 119, 47030 San Mauro Pascoli (FC), Italy, VAT no. IT04862390400, tax code DLTNRN80C02I158W. For any question about your data write to info@letrionlabs.it.

2. In short

  • The website uses no cookies, analytics, pixels or tracking tools, and loads no fonts or scripts from external services.
  • The desktop app processes combat data on your computer. It only reaches our servers if you sign in with Discord and choose to upload a fight.
  • We do not sell or share data with third parties and we do not process payment data.

3. What data we process and why

Visiting the website

When you visit the website, the server and the hosting provider record IP address, date and time, requested page and browser type in their technical logs. The IP address is also used, in memory only, to limit the number of download requests. Purpose: running and securing the website. Legal basis: legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

Signing in with Discord

If you sign in with Discord from the app we receive and store your Discord account ID, display name and avatar, plus the date you registered and last signed in. The session is stored only as a cryptographic hash of the token and expires after 90 days of inactivity. We never receive your email or password. Purpose: providing your account and the online features. Legal basis: performance of the service you request (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).

Uploaded combat logs

When you upload a fight we store the fight data (boss, duration, damage, healing, classes, region, app version and the names of the in-game characters in the fight), the visibility you choose and the view count. On public and unlisted logs your Discord name and avatar are shown as the uploader. Public logs feed per-class statistics in aggregate form, without names. Legal basis: performance of the service (Art. 6(1)(b)) and, for other players' character names, the legitimate interest in showing the complete fight (Art. 6(1)(f)). If you appear in a log uploaded by someone else you can ask us to remove your name.

Contact

If you email us we process the message only to reply to you.

4. Who we share data with

  • Netsons: hosting provider for the servers and database, processing data on our behalf.
  • Discord: sign-in happens on Discord's pages, which process your data under Discord's own privacy policy.
  • GitHub: the download button redirects you to the app file on GitHub, which receives your IP address under its own privacy policy.
  • Patreon: Patreon links take you to its website; any payment is handled entirely by Patreon.

5. How long

  • Account: until you ask us to delete it.
  • Uploaded logs: until you delete them from the app or ask us to delete your account.
  • Sessions: deleted after 90 days of inactivity or on sign-out. Temporary sign-in codes: a few minutes.
  • Server technical logs: for the limited time needed for security and troubleshooting.

6. Your rights

You have the right to access, rectify and erase your data, restrict its processing, receive it in a portable format and object to processing based on legitimate interest. You can delete your logs at any time from the app; to delete your account or exercise the other rights write to info@letrionlabs.it. You can also lodge a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority (garanteprivacy.it) or with the authority of the country where you live.

7. Children

The Service is not intended for anyone under 14. Signing in requires a Discord account, subject to Discord's age limits.

8. Security

All traffic uses HTTPS only, session tokens are stored as hashes and database access is restricted to the server. No system is one hundred percent secure: if you find a problem, please tell us.

9. Cookies

The website uses no cookies. Details are in the cookie policy.

10. Changes

We may update this policy. The last-updated date is shown at the top; significant changes will be announced on the website or in the app's release notes.
